Johnson & Johnson DePuy Synthes Sale Rumors
: Apollo in talks to buy Johnson & Johnson’s DePuy Synthes unit for about $20B; deal or public spin-off possible, sources say, with an agreement potentially within weeks.
: Johnson & Johnson’s hips-and-knees unit posted about $9.3B in sales last year, under 10% of total revenue; company is pursuing a separation into a standalone business.
: HSBC raised its price target for Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) from $290 to $320 per share, updating its valuation outlook for the stock.
: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) launched Ottava, an FDA‑cleared surgical robot; pursuing approvals in Western Europe and Japan. Surgery unit H1 revenue $5.16B, up 4.3% year‑over‑year.
: JNJ said Rybrevant plus chemo showed the longest reported median overall survival to date in NSCLC patients with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, per clinical survival data for that subgroup.
: JNJ won CE Mark for ACUVUE OASYS MAX 2-Week lens with OptiBlue light filter, TearStable tech and UV blocking. Rollout starts in select European markets in 2026, wider expansion planned 2027–28.
